name: Daemon startup configuration
logic_name: Validate bounded daemon settings and require authenticated public TCP

test_list.description: Reject zero or excessive event buffers and invalid graceful shutdown limits.
Reject a non-loopback listener unless server certificate, private key, and client CA are all configured.
Reject ambiguous endpoint selection and invalid local endpoint values before startup.

inputs.name: listen
inputs.description: Loopback plaintext or mTLS-protected public TCP listener.

output_description: Validated explicit daemon configuration; no implicit public listener or credential.
